author: MusTnkr
quote: A game made by women, for women. After 15 hours of gameplay there hasnt been a single funny cutscene. Woke "humour", not a bit of edge, relationship simulator. For some reason the writers didn't realize 90% of their fans are men. Men who want to play something fun after working the whole day. A moment to leave reality for a few hours and do things they will never do in real life. But no, paint a wall for your cheating girlfriend!
